description: This file defines an abstract base class for file storage backends, outlining the interface that concrete storage implementations (such as Azure Blob Storage, S3, GCS) should implement.

classes.name: BaseFileStorageBackend
classes.description: An abstract base class specifying the interface for file storage backends, including methods for uploading, downloading, and optionally deleting files.

methods.name: str upload_file( self, file_content: bytes, filename: str, content_type: str, path_prefix: Optional[str] = None, file_naming_strategy: str = "uuid", )
methods.description: Abstract method to upload a file to the storage backend, returning a URL where the file can be accessed.

methods.name: bytes download_file(self, storage_url: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to download a file from the storage backend given its URL.

methods.name: None delete_file(self, storage_url: str)
methods.description: Optional method to delete a file from the storage backend; default implementation is a no-op.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_file(self, storage_url: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: download_file
ctags.pattern: /^    async def download_file(self, storage_url: str) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.signature: ( self, file_content: bytes, filename: str, content_type: str, path_prefix: Optional[str] = None, file_naming_strategy: str = "uuid", )
